**Overview of the Third Quarter**


- Disposed of thirteen apartment communities consisting of 1,634 homes for an aggregate sales price of $288.8 million, bringing total aggregate sales price on dispositions during the year to $318.8 million;
- Fully repaid the line of credit balances and reduced borrowing capacity by $150.0 million to $250.0 million, contributing to a $4.6 million decrease in interest expense compared to the same period in the prior year and driving net debt to Adjusted EBITDA of 6.3x;
- Revenue decreased by $11.9 million or 16.6% to $59.5 million, compared to $71.4 million for the same period of the prior year, primarily due to the sale of 14 apartment communities during the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 12 apartment communities in the prior year, offset by increased revenue from non-same-store communities;
- Same-store revenues were flat year over year, while property operating expenses increased by 4.2%, partially due to a large one-time utility expense of $200,000, resulting in a 2.7% decrease in same-store NOI compared to the same period of the prior year;
- Net income was $7.28 per diluted share, compared to net income of $3.19 per diluted share for the same period of the prior year primarily due to the higher gain on sale of real estate and other investments of $150.3 million compared to $79.5 million in the same period of the prior year; and
- Core FFO per diluted share decreased 6.7% to $1.11, compared to $1.19 for the same period of the prior year, primarily reflecting dispositions in 2026 and 2025, partially offset by higher NOI from non-same-store communities and lower casualty loss and lower interest expense.


**Balance Sheet**


At the end of the third quarter, Centerspace had $366.2 million of total liquidity on its balance sheet, consisting of $250.0 million available under its line of credit and cash and cash equivalents of $116.2 million.


**Pending IRT Business Combination**


On September 8, 2026, Centerspace entered into a merger agreement with Independence Realty Trust, Inc. ("IRT") and the other parties thereto. Under the agreement, as amended, each outstanding Centerspace common share, other than specified excluded shares, will be converted into the right to receive 3.8 shares of IRT common stock, subject to adjustments provided in the agreement, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares. Completion remains subject to required shareholder approvals and other closing conditions. Centerspace has scheduled a special meeting of shareholders for November 10, 2026. Additional information is available in the definitive joint proxy statement/prospectus and the Company's SEC filings.


**2026 Financial Outlook**


In light of the proposed merger with IRT announced on September 8, 2026, Centerspace will no longer provide guidance nor is it affirming past guidance.


**Upcoming Events**


Centerspace to hold a special meeting of shareholders on November 10, 2026 at 9:30 a.m. Central Time.


**Supplemental Information**


Supplemental Operating and Financial Data for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 included herein ("Supplemental Information") is available in the Investors section on Centerspace's website at[https://www.centerspacehomes.com](https://www.centerspacehomes.com/) or by calling Investor Relations at 952-401-6600. Non-GAAP financial measures and other capitalized terms, as used in this earnings release, are defined and reconciled in the Supplemental Financial and Operating Data, which accompanies this earnings release.


**About Centerspace**


*Centerspace is an owner and operator of apartment communities committed to providing great homes by focusing on integrity and serving others. Founded in 1970, as of September* *30, 2026, Centerspace owned 47* *apartment communities consisting of 10,456* *homes located in Colorad* *o, Minnesota, Montana, Nebraska, North Dakota, and Utah. Centerspace was named a Top Workplace in 2026 by USA Today and for the seventh consecutive year in 2026 by the* Minnesota Star Tribune *. For more information, please visit[www.centerspacehomes.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812313-1&h=477246318&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.centerspacehomes.com&a=www.centerspacehomes.com) .*
